name: anonymous-app
description: Aplicação web ANONYMOUS - Q&A anônimo com monetização

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && npm run activate-venv && python src/main.py
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && pnpm install && pnpm run build
scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && npm run create-venv && npm run install-requirements
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && npm run activate-venv && python -m pytest tests/
scripts.seed: cd backend && npm run activate-venv && python scripts/seed.py
scripts.migrate: cd backend && npm run activate-venv && python scripts/migrate.py
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && npm run activate-venv && gunicorn -w 4 -b 0.0.0.0:5000 src.main:app
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.clean: rm -rf frontend/node_modules frontend/dist backend/venv backend/__pycache__ backend/src/__pycache__
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && npm run activate-venv && flake8 src/ tests/

author: Manus AI
